meta.description: The curtain is about to raise once more. To the staff that this doesn't concern, please leave.

units.rawText: Dammit, she's flying all over the place... Persicaria, I'm going after her!
units.displayText: Dammit, she's flying all over the place... Persicaria, I'm going after her!

spans.text: Dammit, she's flying all over the place... Persicaria, I'm going after her!

units.rawText: Something's not right... Sol, come back!
units.displayText: Something's not right... Sol, come back!

spans.text: Something's not right... Sol, come back!

units.rawText: Huh? Okay!
units.displayText: Huh? Okay!

spans.text: Huh? Okay!

units.rawText: Sol bisects the Entropic creature charging up behind her with a swing of her sword and jumps back to Persicaria's side.
units.displayText: Sol bisects the Entropic creature charging up behind her with a swing of her sword and jumps back to Persicaria's side.

spans.text: Sol bisects the Entropic creature charging up behind her with a swing of her sword and jumps back to Persicaria's side.

units.rawText: What's wrong, Persy?
units.displayText: What's wrong, Persy?

spans.text: What's wrong, Persy?

units.rawText: Um, I think our pursuit was TOO successful...
units.displayText: Um, I think our pursuit was TOO successful...

spans.text: Um, I think our pursuit was TOO successful...

units.rawText: Sol, can you send me your combat logs?
units.displayText: Sol, can you send me your combat logs?

spans.text: Sol, can you send me your combat logs?

units.rawText: Let me sort out the terrain info... There we go!
units.displayText: Let me sort out the terrain info... There we go!

spans.text: Let me sort out the terrain info... There we go!

units.rawText: Thanks...
units.displayText: Thanks...

spans.text: Thanks...

units.rawText: As I thought.
units.displayText: As I thought.

spans.text: As I thought.

units.rawText: What did you find?
units.displayText: What did you find?

spans.text: What did you find?

units.rawText: Odile's speed and the Low-Order Entropics' blockade ought to be enough to shake us. But she seems to be trying to lure us somewhere...
units.displayText: Odile's speed and the Low-Order Entropics' blockade ought to be enough to shake us. But she seems to be trying to lure us somewhere...

spans.text: Odile's speed and the Low-Order Entropics' blockade ought to be enough to shake us. But she seems to be trying to lure us somewhere...

units.rawText: Oh, so it's reverse-tracking, then? I'm familiar with that, let me take a look.
units.displayText: Oh, so it's reverse-tracking, then? I'm familiar with that, let me take a look.

spans.text: Oh, so it's reverse-tracking, then? I'm familiar with that, let me take a look.

units.rawText: You're dead on, Persicaria. I just analyzed our pursuit route and our current terrain info. If we continue on the route we're going down, she's trying to lead us here...
units.displayText: You're dead on, Persicaria. I just analyzed our pursuit route and our current terrain info. If we continue on the route we're going down, she's trying to lead us here...

spans.text: You're dead on, Persicaria. I just analyzed our pursuit route and our current terrain info. If we continue on the route we're going down, she's trying to lead us here...

units.rawText: That's... the direction of the ecological observation post.
units.displayText: That's... the direction of the ecological observation post.

spans.text: That's... the direction of the ecological observation post.

units.rawText: So you CAN say useful things after all!
units.displayText: So you CAN say useful things after all!

spans.text: So you CAN say useful things after all!

units.rawText: This is bad... Can't let her go there.
units.displayText: This is bad... Can't let her go there.

spans.text: This is bad... Can't let her go there.

units.rawText: The observation post? What's there?
units.displayText: The observation post? What's there?

spans.text: The observation post? What's there?

units.rawText: She clammed up again. Was that just an automated response?
units.displayText: She clammed up again. Was that just an automated response?

spans.text: She clammed up again. Was that just an automated response?

units.rawText: Well, at least we've verified the location. We can head out now.
units.displayText: Well, at least we've verified the location. We can head out now.

spans.text: Well, at least we've verified the location. We can head out now.

units.rawText: But Persy, we can't catch up with Odile even if we know her destination.
units.displayText: But Persy, we can't catch up with Odile even if we know her destination.

spans.text: But Persy, we can't catch up with Odile even if we know her destination.

units.rawText: Let's head to the ecological observation post.
units.displayText: Let's head to the ecological observation post.

spans.text: Let's head to the ecological observation post.

units.rawText: We can't let Odile go, can we? Why don't you go to the ecological observation post while I go after her first?
units.displayText: We can't let Odile go, can we? Why don't you go to the ecological observation post while I go after her first?

spans.text: We can't let Odile go, can we? Why don't you go to the ecological observation post while I go after her first?

units.rawText: If you and Persy are right, then Odile won't run away.
units.displayText: If you and Persy are right, then Odile won't run away.

spans.text: If you and Persy are right, then Odile won't run away.

units.rawText: All we need to do is head to the observation post and intercept her.
units.displayText: All we need to do is head to the observation post and intercept her.

spans.text: All we need to do is head to the observation post and intercept her.

units.rawText: Yes. Miss De Lacey, could you lend me some operands?
units.displayText: Yes. Miss De Lacey, could you lend me some operands?

spans.text: Yes. Miss De Lacey, could you lend me some operands?

units.rawText: Uh... Y-you want to borrow operands...?
units.displayText: Uh... Y-you want to borrow operands...?

spans.text: Uh... Y-you want to borrow operands...?

units.rawText: Oh, I'm sorry. We're just temporary partners, asking you for operands is just rude...
units.displayText: Oh, I'm sorry. We're just temporary partners, asking you for operands is just rude...

spans.text: Oh, I'm sorry. We're just temporary partners, asking you for operands is just rude...

units.rawText: Well, that's not the problem. It's just that the way I give operands is a little... rough.
units.displayText: Well, that's not the problem. It's just that the way I give operands is a little... rough.

spans.text: Well, that's not the problem. It's just that the way I give operands is a little... rough.

units.rawText: De Lacey's tail swishes around as she speaks.
units.displayText: De Lacey's tail swishes around as she speaks.

spans.text: De Lacey's tail swishes around as she speaks.

units.rawText: That's alright, now's not the time to quibble about such details.
units.displayText: That's alright, now's not the time to quibble about such details.

spans.text: That's alright, now's not the time to quibble about such details.

units.rawText: Hehe, then allow me~
units.displayText: Hehe, then allow me~

spans.text: Hehe, then allow me~

units.rawText: Um... That really is an unexpected method. Do we really have to do this?
units.displayText: Um... That really is an unexpected method. Do we really have to do this?

spans.text: Um... That really is an unexpected method. Do we really have to do this?

units.rawText: You desperately need operands right now, don't you, Persy? Just bear with it, because here~ I~ come~
units.displayText: You desperately need operands right now, don't you, Persy? Just bear with it, because here~ I~ come~

spans.text: You desperately need operands right now, don't you, Persy? Just bear with it, because here~ I~ come~

units.rawText: Ohhhhh!? I didn't think you could use your tail that way. That's a Doll maintenance technician for you!
units.displayText: Ohhhhh!? I didn't think you could use your tail that way. That's a Doll maintenance technician for you!

spans.text: Ohhhhh!? I didn't think you could use your tail that way. That's a Doll maintenance technician for you!

units.rawText: After finishing their preparations, Persicaria and company rush straight to the ecological observation post.
units.displayText: After finishing their preparations, Persicaria and company rush straight to the ecological observation post.

spans.text: After finishing their preparations, Persicaria and company rush straight to the ecological observation post.

units.rawText: This is it. Ahead of us should be...
units.displayText: This is it. Ahead of us should be...

spans.text: This is it. Ahead of us should be...

units.rawText: Hm!? Wait a minute, it's Odile!
units.displayText: Hm!? Wait a minute, it's Odile!

spans.text: Hm!? Wait a minute, it's Odile!

units.rawText: A black figure is floating in the air not far from the observation post.
units.displayText: A black figure is floating in the air not far from the observation post.

spans.text: A black figure is floating in the air not far from the observation post.

units.rawText: She hovers above the ocean's surface, flapping her roughly-formed black wings as she stares at the Dolls with an ice-cold gaze.
units.displayText: She hovers above the ocean's surface, flapping her roughly-formed black wings as she stares at the Dolls with an ice-cold gaze.

spans.text: She hovers above the ocean's surface, flapping her roughly-formed black wings as she stares at the Dolls with an ice-cold gaze.

units.rawText: We meet again, o dragon-slaying heroes.
units.displayText: We meet again, o dragon-slaying heroes.

spans.text: We meet again, o dragon-slaying heroes.

units.rawText: It seems you predicted how the script would go. How talented.
units.displayText: It seems you predicted how the script would go. How talented.

spans.text: It seems you predicted how the script would go. How talented.

units.rawText: However, peeking backstage ruins the experience. A proper audience should not do such things.
units.displayText: However, peeking backstage ruins the experience. A proper audience should not do such things.

spans.text: However, peeking backstage ruins the experience. A proper audience should not do such things.

units.rawText: Can't you talk like a normal person!?
units.displayText: Can't you talk like a normal person!?

spans.text: Can't you talk like a normal person!?

units.rawText: Did you split the bedrock and cause that tsunami?
units.displayText: Did you split the bedrock and cause that tsunami?

spans.text: Did you split the bedrock and cause that tsunami?

units.rawText: The Master needs a seedbed. Finding a new stage for her is our mission.
units.displayText: The Master needs a seedbed. Finding a new stage for her is our mission.

spans.text: The Master needs a seedbed. Finding a new stage for her is our mission.

units.rawText: All the necessary conditions are present here. That is all.
units.displayText: All the necessary conditions are present here. That is all.

spans.text: All the necessary conditions are present here. That is all.

units.rawText: I knew it. The underground has been infested by the Entropy... That means the Professor and Antonina...
units.displayText: I knew it. The underground has been infested by the Entropy... That means the Professor and Antonina...

spans.text: I knew it. The underground has been infested by the Entropy... That means the Professor and Antonina...

units.rawText: You actually understood that, Persicaria!?
units.displayText: You actually understood that, Persicaria!?

spans.text: You actually understood that, Persicaria!?

units.rawText: How are the Prof and Anna? Did you meet them underground!?
units.displayText: How are the Prof and Anna? Did you meet them underground!?

spans.text: How are the Prof and Anna? Did you meet them underground!?

units.rawText: Hehe... There are more suitable stages for such rising stars with bright futures. More heart-rending tragedies await them...
units.displayText: Hehe... There are more suitable stages for such rising stars with bright futures. More heart-rending tragedies await them...

spans.text: Hehe... There are more suitable stages for such rising stars with bright futures. More heart-rending tragedies await them...

units.rawText: As for you... it is time for you to make your exit!
units.displayText: As for you... it is time for you to make your exit!

spans.text: As for you... it is time for you to make your exit!

units.rawText: In an instant, Odile turns into a cold, black streak diving straight for Sol.
units.displayText: In an instant, Odile turns into a cold, black streak diving straight for Sol.

spans.text: In an instant, Odile turns into a cold, black streak diving straight for Sol.

units.rawText: Hyaaa!
units.displayText: Hyaaa!

spans.text: Hyaaa!

units.rawText:
Sol immediately draws her longsword and ruthlessly slashes forward.
Blade and claw collide with a sharp clang.
units.displayText:
Sol immediately draws her longsword and ruthlessly slashes forward.
Blade and claw collide with a sharp clang.

spans.text:
Sol immediately draws her longsword and ruthlessly slashes forward.
Blade and claw collide with a sharp clang.

units.rawText: Humph... Is that all you have after becoming Entropized?
units.displayText: Humph... Is that all you have after becoming Entropized?

spans.text: Humph... Is that all you have after becoming Entropized?

units.rawText:
Sol blocks Odile's attack with sheer force, halting her advance.
As she maintains her grip on her sword, Sol adjusts her posture so that she can reach for the shortsword on the right side of her waist.
units.displayText:
Sol blocks Odile's attack with sheer force, halting her advance.
As she maintains her grip on her sword, Sol adjusts her posture so that she can reach for the shortsword on the right side of her waist.

spans.text:

As she maintains her grip on her sword, Sol adjusts her posture so that she can reach for the shortsword on the right side of her waist.

units.rawText:
If Odile retreats, she can immediately draw the shortsword and cut her open.
But if Odile continues maintaining the lock, she won't be able to avoid the other's attacks.
units.displayText:
If Odile retreats, she can immediately draw the shortsword and cut her open.
But if Odile continues maintaining the lock, she won't be able to avoid the other's attacks.

spans.text:

units.rawText: You stepped into it this time.
units.displayText: You stepped into it this time.

spans.text: You stepped into it this time.

units.rawText: Battle was never the specialty of this body, and the Master's modifications are not yet complete...
units.displayText: Battle was never the specialty of this body, and the Master's modifications are not yet complete...

spans.text: Battle was never the specialty of this body, and the Master's modifications are not yet complete...

units.rawText: Which is why I have no intention of relying on brute strength like a fool.
units.displayText: Which is why I have no intention of relying on brute strength like a fool.

spans.text: Which is why I have no intention of relying on brute strength like a fool.

units.rawText: In the next moment, underdeveloped tentacles emerge from under Odile's wings, spraying liquid Entropy.
units.displayText: In the next moment, underdeveloped tentacles emerge from under Odile's wings, spraying liquid Entropy.

spans.text: In the next moment, underdeveloped tentacles emerge from under Odile's wings, spraying liquid Entropy.

units.rawText: Sol knows she can't block that in time, so she kicks Odile away and leans back to avoid the spray of Entropy.
units.displayText: Sol knows she can't block that in time, so she kicks Odile away and leans back to avoid the spray of Entropy.

spans.text: Sol knows she can't block that in time, so she kicks Odile away and leans back to avoid the spray of Entropy.

units.rawText: Even so, a few drops manage to make contact with her lower abdomen.
units.displayText: Even so, a few drops manage to make contact with her lower abdomen.

spans.text: Even so, a few drops manage to make contact with her lower abdomen.

units.rawText: A green glow envelops the area where the liquid Entropy touches her skin almost instantly. A thin barrier of operands neutralize the Entropy, which crumbles into white operand particles before falling off.
units.displayText: A green glow envelops the area where the liquid Entropy touches her skin almost instantly. A thin barrier of operands neutralize the Entropy, which crumbles into white operand particles before falling off.

spans.text: A green glow envelops the area where the liquid Entropy touches her skin almost instantly. A thin barrier of operands neutralize the Entropy, which crumbles into white operand particles before falling off.

units.rawText: Thanks, Persicaria!
units.displayText: Thanks, Persicaria!

spans.text: Thanks, Persicaria!

units.rawText: Careful! She's fled onto the sea!
units.displayText: Careful! She's fled onto the sea!

spans.text: Careful! She's fled onto the sea!

units.rawText:
Having failed in her attack, Odile is now hovering over the water again. She seems to be using the ocean as a natural barrier.
Nobody present can move on water, which means they can't strike back at her.
units.displayText:
Having failed in her attack, Odile is now hovering over the water again. She seems to be using the ocean as a natural barrier.

spans.text: I can't reach her with my blades. Persicaria, can you attack from afar?

units.rawText: I can't aim properly; she's too agile!
units.displayText: I can't aim properly; she's too agile!

spans.text: I can't aim properly; she's too agile!

units.rawText: Dammit, if I'd known I should have had the Prof assign me a cannon...
units.displayText: Dammit, if I'd known I should have had the Prof assign me a cannon...

units.rawText: Solly! She's coming in for another pass!
units.displayText: Solly! She's coming in for another pass!

spans.text: Solly! She's coming in for another pass!

units.rawText: Hah!
units.displayText: Hah!

spans.text: Hah!

units.displayText: Sol slashes at the place where Odile is diving, but they both miss each other again.

spans.text: Sol slashes at the place where Odile is diving, but they both miss each other again.

units.displayText: Humph... Stage combat is quite tedious.

units.rawText: It's time to introduce some variation...
units.displayText: It's time to introduce some variation...

spans.text: It's time to introduce some variation...

units.displayText: Odile turns around in mid-air and rushes at Persicaria, who's providing Sol with a shield.

spans.text: Odile turns around in mid-air and rushes at Persicaria, who's providing Sol with a shield.

units.rawText: Urgh—
units.displayText: Urgh—

spans.text: Urgh—

units.rawText: S-Sol!
units.displayText: S-Sol!

spans.text: S-Sol!

units.rawText: Keep your eyes on me! I'm your opponent here!
units.displayText: Keep your eyes on me! I'm your opponent here!

spans.text: Keep your eyes on me! I'm your opponent here!

units.rawText: Sol manages to get in front of Persicaria in time and deflects Odile's attack again.
units.displayText: Sol manages to get in front of Persicaria in time and deflects Odile's attack again.

spans.text: Sol manages to get in front of Persicaria in time and deflects Odile's attack again.

units.rawText: Persicaria, Delly, move up close and back me up with operands!
units.displayText: Persicaria, Delly, move up close and back me up with operands!

spans.text: Persicaria, Delly, move up close and back me up with operands!

units.rawText: And bring that dorky administrator over too! Don't give her a chance to make another ambush!
units.displayText: And bring that dorky administrator over too! Don't give her a chance to make another ambush!

spans.text: And bring that dorky administrator over too! Don't give her a chance to make another ambush!

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Fighting wild beasts is my specialty!
units.displayText: Fighting wild beasts is my specialty!

spans.text: Fighting wild beasts is my specialty!

units.rawText: I can protect you at this range!
units.displayText: I can protect you at this range!

spans.text: I can protect you at this range!

units.rawText: We'll wear her down and look for an opening!
units.displayText: We'll wear her down and look for an opening!

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.displayText: Odile dives several more times, but Sol blocks her attempts to attack repeatedly.

spans.text: Odile dives several more times, but Sol blocks her attempts to attack repeatedly.

units.rawText:
However, contrary to their expectations, Odile's movements do not grow slower over time. In fact she seems to be gaining strength as she fights.
In fact, it is Sol who is first starting to tire under the relentless assault.

units.rawText: That's strange... She's been flapping around in the sky all this time, how is she not slowing down?

spans.text: That's strange... She's been flapping around in the sky all this time, how is she not slowing down?

units.rawText: Is she a monster? Okay, she IS a monster...
units.displayText: Is she a monster? Okay, she IS a monster...

spans.text: Is she a monster? Okay, she IS a monster...

units.rawText: Where are you looking? Showing the audience your back is a rookie mistake in theater!
units.displayText: Where are you looking? Showing the audience your back is a rookie mistake in theater!

units.rawText: Yeeart!
units.displayText: Yeeart!

units.displayText: Oh please, I can split my attention when dealing with the likes of you!

units.rawText: Hehe... A grand performance is about to begin...

units.rawText: And you are both the audience and the dancers—
units.displayText: And you are both the audience and the dancers—

units.rawText: Urgh!
units.displayText: Urgh!

spans.text: Urgh!

units.rawText: Dammit... What a pain...
units.displayText: Dammit... What a pain...

spans.text: Dammit... What a pain...

units.displayText: We can't go on like this, she'll wear us out.

units.rawText: Ahhhhh seriously!

units.rawText: If only I could fly too!

units.displayText: Sol, I've got an idea!

units.rawText: Oh, that's Persicaria for you!

units.displayText: Miss De Lacey!

units.rawText: Always happy to help!
units.displayText: Always happy to help!

units.rawText: Huh? Why did you call Delly—

spans.text: Huh? Why did you call Delly—

units.rawText: Er, wait, don't tell me you're going to...!
units.displayText: Er, wait, don't tell me you're going to...!

units.rawText: Solly Missile, fire—!
units.displayText: Solly Missile, fire—!

spans.text: Solly Missile, fire—!

units.rawText: You!?
units.displayText: You!?

spans.text: You!?

units.rawText: Like a loosed arrow, Sol shoots out and instantly catches up with Odile in mid-air.
units.displayText: Like a loosed arrow, Sol shoots out and instantly catches up with Odile in mid-air.

units.rawText:
Odile tries to evade her, but one of her wings suddenly loses balance.
—Persicaria's Hashrate attack has caught up with her right at this moment.

units.rawText: Wire-fu isn't exactly an easy thing. Thank you, Miss Odile.

units.rawText: You—
units.displayText: You—

spans.text: You—

units.rawText: SEARING LION SLASH!
units.displayText: SEARING LION SLASH!

spans.text: SEARING LION SLASH!

units.rawText: Sol's twin blades instantly ignite and cut down mercilessly toward Odile.
units.displayText: Sol's twin blades instantly ignite and cut down mercilessly toward Odile.

units.rawText: Urgh—guwaaaargh!

spans.text: Urgh—guwaaaargh!

units.rawText: A crescent of flame cuts through the air, and the blazing edges of Sol's blades instantly ignite the feathers on Odile's wings.

units.rawText: Sol makes a neat landing. At the same time, Odile crashes heavily into the ground without her wings to support her.

units.rawText: Brought you down at last.

units.rawText: <size=44>Hehe... Hahahahahaha!</size>
units.displayText: Hehe... Hahahahahaha!

units.rawText: Well fought. I approve of your performance.
